results.title: Pidilite - Industrial Adhesives, Pigments, Paints, Bonding and Waterproofing Solutions
results.renderedTextPreview: About Us We are Pidilite Since 1959, we have been strengthening our bonds with our customers, by continuing to innovate, pioneer new products, and launch specialised services. This has helped us build trust in India and around the world. Know our story INR 13,093 Crores Net Sales 8,153 Number of Employees 80+ Countries 25+ Brands 68 Manufacturing Units in India Our Categories, Brands and Businesses Adhesives, Pigments, Waterproofing and more We are committed to making a difference - with superior solutions for adhesives, automotives, textiles, arts and crafts and waterproofing, woodworking and MEP solutions. We believe that a truly innovative solution or a quality sealant can change our customers’ lives for the better. Categories Woodworking Adhesives An industry leader in adhesives that are made strong through water-based, solvent-based and hot melt technologies. Waterproofing Innovative construction chemicals that are tailored to meet the requirements of various construction projects. Tile and Stone fixing World-class products to suit various tile applications and care - fixing tile-on-tile, new tiles, grouts for tile joints and tile cleaners. Maintenance and Repair Trustworthy and suitable products and services, such as instant bond adhesives, leak repair, speciality coatings, , sealants, lubricants and more. Art, Stationary, Fabric Care Beloved Craft Adhesives and Art Colors like white glues, glue sticks, acrylic paints, and tempera colours. Industrial Products Specialty
